kind: combined SHA512 schedule and round AIR
formal_claims: Actual AIR satisfaction projects to both component sequence AIRs with next-row and selector semantics preserved.
Every round consumes the head of its current constrained schedule window.
Any nonempty segment and the whole trace compute actual SHA512.rounds using decoded per-row constants.
limitations: The test supplies H0, message padding, round80 endpoint and feed-forward externally.
No circuit proof of complete SHA512 padding/digest/block chaining yet.
Full NEAR state transitions, 1 Pgas proving, sub-300 KB proof size and 128-bit quantum soundness remain unverified.
